preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n, m, grid in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each grid has between 1 and 200,000 rows.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= 2 * 10**5 for n, m, grid in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each grid has between 1 and 200,000 columns.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i][j] <= 10**9 for n, m, grid in test_cases for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid contains a positive integer between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: sum(n * m for n, m, grid in test_cases) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The total number of cells across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= m for x in return_value.split()))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or two integers representing the indices of the columns to be swapped.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(all(grid[i][j] <= grid[i][j+1] for j in range(m-1)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If a swap is possible, the resulting grid is good (each row is sorted in non-decreasing order).
